punchline: Jack Canfield asks his wife every week to rate their relationship from 1 to 10.
thirty_sec: Jack Canfield compares chasing a goal to a flight: the plane is off its line most of the time, and the pilot keeps correcting from the instruments. The problem is that people around us rarely say we've drifted, because they're worried how we'll react. So he asks directly: on a scale of 1 to 10, how would you rate our relationship? He says he asks his wife and coworkers every week, and anything under ten usually comes with a concrete suggestion.
